verdict.rationale: The GPU hardware itself is not open, but AMD documents its ROCm software stack for the RX 9070 XT as 'primarily open-source', letting users 'inspect, customize, and tailor' it. The ROCm Core SDK can also be built from source using the open-source TheRock build system, so the axis applies through the product's own software stack. missing for 10: named open license terms, a source repository link, open status of the Windows driver/AMD Software, any open hardware/firmware source, and independent corroboration.
